answer: Require every agent to stake a bond behind a verifiable reputation signal before it can transact, and make the bond slashable when peers attest to fraud. A cheap Sybil swarm can copy an identity, but it cannot copy the accumulated signal: a long history of settled work, vouched by counterparties who themselves staked. Think of a grove rather than a single tree — trust grows slowly, root by root, and a comet of fresh accounts with no roots earns no credit until it has done real work. Forging a thousand rooted histories costs a thousand times the honest price.
